text: Over-approval is moral hazard in the monitoring layer itself: the validation pool is the substrate’s monitor, and a pool that approves work failing ground truth is a monitor whose verdicts have decoupled from the quantity it exists to verify, the adjudicator’s failure mode that the incomplete-contracts tradition predicts wherever quality is adjudicated ex post.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Empirical Evaluation of the Agentic Reputation Substrate: Deliberation, the Composition of Error, and the Registered Measurement of Agency Costs in a Controlled Multi-Model Cohort (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7261018
